intent: loan table records
description: Exact match on the 'loan' entity name

intent: transaction entries in the database
description: Exact match on the 'trans' entity name

intent: how frequently is the account statement issued
description: Exact match on the 'frequency' attribute of account

intent: district location and region data
description: Exact match on the 'district' entity name

intent: customer personal profile
description: 'customer' is a synonym for 'client' in this dataset

intent: money transfer value in a transaction
description: 'value' / 'transfer amount' maps to the 'amount' column

intent: monthly repayment installment
description: 'installment' maps to loan.payments

intent: cash withdrawal or deposit transaction type
description: 'withdrawal' and 'deposit' are coded values of trans.operation

intent: geographic region or area of the client
description: 'region' / 'geographic area' maps to district entity and its a3 (region) column

intent: running total of money remaining in the account
description: 'running total' is the semantic role of trans.balance (STATE_VARIABLE)

intent: whether the loan was repaid or went into default
description: Repayment outcome is encoded in loan.status (A=repaid, B=default, C=running/OK, D=running/debt)

intent: which external bank received the wire transfer
description: External bank name is stored in trans.bank

intent: purpose or reason code for a bank transaction
description: Transaction reason is the Czech k_symbol code (POJISTNE=insurance, DUCHOD=pension, etc.)

intent: age or birth year of the account holder
description: Client age is derived from birth_date in the client table

intent: how many months does the loan last
description: Loan term length is stored in loan.duration (in months)

intent: date when the loan was approved or granted
description: Loan origination date is loan.date; tests disambiguation from account.date

intent: date when the bank account was opened or created
description: Account opening date is account.date; tests disambiguation from loan.date

intent: unique identifier for a banking transaction record
description: Primary key of the transaction table is trans_id

intent: accounts that have an associated active loan
description: Spans account and loan entities, joined on account_id

intent: client spending and purchase history
description: Spans client, account, and trans entities
